DROP TABLE [d360].[DELETED_CIFS_IN_FCBS]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE  TABLE  [d360].[STG_CRM_DELETEDCIF]
( 
	[BANK_ID] [Nvarchar](8)  NULL,
	[ORGKEY] [nvarchar](50)  NULL,
	[DATE] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	CONTROL_NON [nvarchar](50),
	DATEOFDELETION DATE,
	TMDATE datetime2
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO

TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.CRM_CUSTOMER_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CIF_ID,[ROLE],CIF_TYPE,SALE_CUST_TMDATE,SALESID,BANK_ID,ACCBRANCHCODE,ACCOUNTNUMBER,PRODCATID,PRODUCTID,PRODUCTTYPE,PRODUCTSKEY,APPLCURRENCY,APPLCREATIONDATE,ACCESSOWNERBC,ACCESSOWNERAGENT,SALES_TMDATE,AMOUNT1,AMOUNT2,ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,ACCOUNTSTATUS,ACCSHORTNAME,SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,GAM_ACID,LAST6_ACCT_NUM))
	AS HASHROW,
	CIF_ID
	,BANK_ID,ACCOUNTNUMBER,[ROLE]
FROM (	SELECT 
[CIF_ID]
,[ROLE]
,[CIF_TYPE]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SALE_CUST_TMDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000')  as [SALE_CUST_TMDATE]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([SALESID],0),0) as SALESID
,[BANK_ID]
,[ACCBRANCHCODE]
,[ACCOUNTNUMBER]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([PRODCATID],0),0) as PRODCATID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([PRODUCTID],0),0) as PRODUCTID
,[PRODUCTTYPE]
,[PRODUCTSKEY]
,[APPLCURRENCY]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(APPLCREATIONDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000')  as [APPLCREATIONDATE]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([ACCESSOWNERBC],0),0) as ACCESSOWNERBC
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([ACCESSOWNERAGENT],0),0) as ACCESSOWNERAGENT
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SALES_TMDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000')  as [SALES_TMDATE]
,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL([AMOUNT1],0),0) as AMOUNT1
,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL([AMOUNT2],0),0) as AMOUNT2
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE
,[ACCOUNTSTATUS]
,[ACCSHORTNAME]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000')  as [SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE]
,[GAM_ACID]
,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [D360].[STG_CRM_CUSTOMER]
 where H = 'D' 

) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CIF_ID,[ROLE],CIF_TYPE,SALE_CUST_TMDATE,SALESID,BANK_ID,ACCBRANCHCODE,ACCOUNTNUMBER,PRODCATID,PRODUCTID,PRODUCTTYPE,PRODUCTSKEY,APPLCURRENCY,APPLCREATIONDATE,ACCESSOWNERBC,ACCESSOWNERAGENT,SALES_TMDATE,AMOUNT1,AMOUNT2,ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,ACCOUNTSTATUS,ACCSHORTNAME,SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,GAM_ACID,LAST6_ACCT_NUM))
	AS HASHROW,
	CIF_ID
	,BANK_ID,ACCOUNTNUMBER,[ROLE]
FROM	BUSC.CRM_CUSTOMER
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.CRM_CUSTOMER_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,CIF_ID,BANK_ID,ACCOUNTNUMBER,[ROLE],isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CIF_ID,TGT.CIF_ID) AS CIF_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACCOUNTNUMBER,TGT.ACCOUNTNUMBER) AS ACCOUNTNUMBER
    ,ISNULL(SRC.[ROLE],TGT.[ROLE]) AS [ROLE]
	
	,CASE WHEN SRC.CIF_ID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.CIF_ID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN CONCAT(TGT.CIF_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) IN (SELECT CONCAT(CIF_ID,BANK_ID) FROM d360.DELETED_CIFS_IN_FCBS) THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.CIF_ID IS NULL AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE 'UPDATE' END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.CIF_ID = TGT.CIF_ID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND	SRC.ACCOUNTNUMBER = TGT.ACCOUNTNUMBER	
AND SRC.[ROLE] = TGT.[ROLE]
	
WHERE	(
TGT.CIF_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
OR CONCAT(TGT.CIF_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) IN (SELECT CONCAT(CIF_ID,BANK_ID) FROM d360.DELETED_CIFS_IN_FCBS)
